continuation.text:
I removed the withdrawn restriction in `src/solution.py`. I didn't run it or write any checks.

The function used to end with `return any(v > 0 for v in resources_copy.values())`. That made an allocation invalid if it used up every resource. It now ends with `return True`, so an allocation that uses all the capacity counts as feasible.

I left everything else alone. It still returns `False` for an unknown resource or a request that exceeds the remaining capacity. It still raises `ValueError` for a request that isn't a dict or for an amount that is negative or not a number.
